bubble--file.note: width follows the bundled Noto Sans SC metrics

button--primary--dark.note: the dark export is a 160 px crop of the 361 pt master

button--secondary--dark.note: the dark export is a crop of the 361 pt master

button--text--dark.note: the dark export is narrower than the 361 pt master

context-menu--default.note: the export canvas includes shadow outside the master

context-menu--restricted.note: the export canvas includes shadow; four rows plus one divider

reaction-bar--default.note: emoji ink draws outside the 44 pt master

sheet--default.note: the export canvas includes shadow outside the master

sheet--no-close.note: the export canvas includes the sheet shadow; this is the link-approval composition frame
